title: When does CCS find truth vs. a salient distractor? A controlled follow-up on unsupervised latent-knowledge probing

original_idea.body:
# When does CCS find truth vs. a distractor?

Inject confounds correlated on train, anti-correlated on test; measure how often CCS tracks truth vs confound.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: maps when unsupervised ELK gets captured by confounds, informing whether consistency identifies truth.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: CCS on open model with injected confounds; clear inherited methodology.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped failure-rate-vs-confound-strength curve with controlled injection.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly: open model, public data, ELK red-teaming valuable.

low_compute.reasoning: CCS on small model, one GPU.

novelty.reasoning: CCS confound capture is documented; the controlled confound-strength sweep may be partially open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: CCS distractor capture is shown; controlled confound-strength mapping may be open.
